title: Small agents should know what their tools do
abstract: arXiv:2610.35981v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Small open language models can call tools, but they do not reason about what a call does: they delete without asking, repeat writes, re-read state they already hold, and issue one call per turn where a short program would do. We introduce EffectWorld, an executable world of effect-typed tools in which every tool declares its effect, whether it is idempotent, and which resources it reads and writes. These declarations let a replay verifier decide whether a trace is effect-safe without labels or judge models, let an executor run tool programs of several dependent calls in one turn, and let a compiler-style optimizer turn wasteful traces into verified training signal; together they make EffectWorld a benchmark of effect safety and call efficiency. Low-rank adapters trained on this data deliver large gains: on Qwen3-4B, they raise task success from 53% to 99% in distribution, from 52% to 81% on a held-out split with unseen task kinds and dis

translated_title: 小型智能体应当了解其工具的作用
translated_abstract: 小型开源语言模型能够调用工具，但它们并不对调用的效果进行推理：它们不加询问就删除、重复写入、重新读取本已掌握的状态，并且每轮只发出一次调用，而一段简短的程序本可完成任务。我们提出了EffectWorld——一个由效应类型工具构成的可执行世界，其中每个工具都声明其效应、是否幂等，以及它读取和写入哪些资源。这些声明使得重放验证器无需标注或评判模型即可判定一条轨迹是否效应安全，使执行器能在单轮中运行包含多个依赖调用的工具程序，并使一个编译器风格的优化器能够将浪费性轨迹转化为经过验证的训练信号；这些共同使EffectWorld成为一个衡量效应安全性与调用效率的基准。在该数据上训练的低秩适配器带来了显著提升：在Qwen3-4B模型上，任务成功率在分布内场景下从53%提升至99%，在包含未见任务类型和分布外元素的保留测试集上从52%提升至81%……
tldr: 本文提出EffectWorld基准，通过为工具添加效应类型声明（幂等性及读写资源），让小型语言模型能够生成效应安全且高效的多调用工具程序，将Qwen3-4B的任务成功率从53%大幅提升至99%。
en_tdlr: EffectWorld introduces effect-typed tool declarations (idempotency and read/write resources) that enable small language models to produce effect-safe and efficient tool programs, dramatically raising Qwen3-4B's task success rate from 53% to 99%.
